stem.en: Put the steps of building an app in order, starting from the request.

text.en: The model writes a plan for the whole app
The model writes one part, with the plan still in the window
The program around the model runs that part
The model reads the error that came back as text
The model writes a fixed version of the part

explanation.en: A plan comes first and stays in the context window, so each part stays small. The model only writes text, so the program around it runs the part and sends any error back as text. Only then can the model write a fix.
